nodes.label: ADR 0150: Connections to other devices in Rust
nodes.rationale: WebRTC data channels and peer connections native in Rust (crates/glue-rtc using webrtc-rs). Eliminates JavaScript WebView for streaming to other devices. Stream channels handle file reads, uploads, cache files in Rust; other channels write incoming folder. Improves speed: 21-30 MB/s vs 8.4 MB/s through JavaScript.
